readme.text:
Two STAF modules
Cost-effectiveness and incremental cost analysis: figures and tables

Study: Two STAF modules
Prepared by: n/a
Date: October 18, 2026
Status: Draft
Made by CEICA 1.0.0 (engine 1); project digest 1147a2ea6d7e

In this folder
  Figures and tables.docx, .pdf and .html: every figure and table with its number and caption, and the methods.
  Figures: each figure as PNG (300 dpi, for documents and slides) and SVG (to edit).
  Tables: each table as CSV, and All tables.xlsx with a sheet per table.
  Two STAF modules calculator.xlsx: every input and result as live formulas.
  Two STAF modules.ceica: the project file. Open it in CEICA to continue the study.

Figures
  Figure 1. Cost-effectiveness (A) and incremental cost (B) of the alternatives at site R1.
    Figures/Figure 01 Site R1.png and .svg
  Figure 2. Ecosystem Condition Index over time (A) and lift by outcome (B) at site R1, Mainstem. The existing condition is 0.40 (Functioning-at-Risk); A2 reaches 0.73 (Functioning) by year 50.
    Figures/Figure 02 STAF, site R1, Mainstem.png and .svg
  Figure 3. Ecosystem Condition Index over time (A) and lift by outcome (B) at site R1, Tributary. The existing condition is 0.60 (Functioning-at-Risk); A2 reaches 0.77 (Functioning) by year 50.
    Figures/Figure 03 STAF, site R1, Tributary.png and .svg
  Figure 4. Habitat units over time (A) and average annual cost by part (B) of the alternatives at site R1.
    Figures/Figure 04 Benefits and costs, site R1.png and .svg

Tables
  Table 1. Study settings and the record of this analysis.
    Tables/Table 01 Study settings.csv
  Table 2. Best-buy plans and their incremental costs. Site columns: 1 when the plan includes the site, 0 when not.
    Tables/Table 02 Best-buy plans.csv
  Table 3. Final array of plans. Site columns: 1 when the plan includes the site, 0 when not.
    Tables/Table 03 Final array.csv
  Table 4. The plans: lift, cost and status (2 plans). Site columns: 1 when the plan includes the site, 0 when not.
    Tables/Table 04 All plans.csv
  Table 5. Cost-effectiveness and incremental cost of every alternative at every site. Incremental cost applies to best buys.
    Tables/Table 05 Alternatives at every site.csv
  Table 6. The alternative each site carries forward, and the status of that decision.
    Tables/Table 06 Site recommendations.csv
  Table 7. Lift of the recommended alternatives by outcome.
    Tables/Table 07 Lift by outcome.csv
  Table 8. Decisions and the reasons recorded for them.
    Tables/Table 08 Decision record.csv
  Table 9. Average annual output, lift, construction cost and annualized cost of every alternative. The CE/ICA tables measure cost above No Action.
    Tables/Table 09 Benefit and cost inputs.csv
  Table 10. Average annual output by module, the total and the lift over No Action (all in AAHU).
    Tables/Table 10 Output by module.csv
  Table 11. First costs by category, interest during construction, OMRRR and annualized cost of every alternative.
    Tables/Table 11 Cost by category.csv

Reading the data files
  CSV files hold plain numbers: lift and cost are the rounded values the analysis compared, so sorting reproduces its ties. TRUE and FALSE mark cost-effective plans and best buys. A blank cell has no value; in a plan table, a blank site column means the site is not in the plan.
  In All tables.xlsx, numbers keep their full precision under the display format, and a missing value reads n/a.
